notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/a207d8531ef242d817a69deecce6c14071e089ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey Wartorn community! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1384323602245222451.webp?size=44"][/img][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1384322192761815201.webp?size=44"][/img][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1384323529289371718.webp?size=44"][/img][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1384323530400727050.webp?size=44"][/img][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1384323527984808059.webp?size=44"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have just deployed a new patch to Wartorn that brings a wide range of fixes, adjustments, and additions based on your feedback and recommendations! This includes changes to the original content as well as the new content added from Content Update 1! [/p][p][/p][h2]Patch - September 25[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various dialogue sequences in the villa.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed feedback regarding overlapping VO lines. Now only the top selected squad will play command barks. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to manually set the hardware cursor size in the options menu. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up code for playing the initial startup movie to address a crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the raid battle enemy spawn pattern. After the initial spawn, enemies will now spawn off screen and flow into the battle. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay and dialogue will now pause when overlay is opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the pause menu if a controller disconnects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added native support for the PS Dualshock4 and Dualsense controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]When a PS controller is active, the UI will now show the correct PS icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur if a dualshock controller is disconnected while Wartorn is active (whether the controller is in use or not).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the squad selector and inspector screens to use RT / R3 instead of select, as it is an easier button to press (especially on PS controllers).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated game's credit scroll.[/p][/*][*][p]The options screen now shows the correct controller image (Xbox, Playstation, or Steam Deck) depending on what is active. [/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue Audio will now pause when the controller disconnects.[/p][/*][*][p]When playing with the steam deck, the UI will now show the correct steam deck icons (and not Xbox icons). [/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to change which gamepad icons are displayed if you wish to override what gamepad is automatically detected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where when keybinding and a duplicate bind was detected, it wouldn't let you cancel and would instead spawn the same dialog a second time. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the hotkey to open the Caravan menu did not work because Center Camera was bound to the same key.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Feedback[/b][/h2][p]Thank you for your continued support with Wartorn! Please continue to report bugs and share your feedback with us by joining the official [url="https://discord.gg/M6KdJ2c64w"]Discord Server! [/url][/p]

notes.title: Content Update 1 - Available Now - Raid Battles, Pitched Battles, and more!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/c4078ceb1a62a9ad6ee26a0c15eda82d8c1ad96d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Patch Notes - Update 1[/b][/h1][p]Hey Wartorn Community! We are very excited to finally have Content Update 1 for you to enjoy in the world of Wartorn! This update brings new content such as the new battle types, a reworked new-user experience, along with new features, balance changes, and bug fixes. We are excited to be on this journey with you and cannot wait to see what you think![/p][p]Of note, users should NOT experience a hard reset/wipe, and your progression should still carry forward after the update. As a precaution, we have provided how to backup your save file at the bottom of these notes.[/p][p]Items listed with the 🏆 next to them signify that they were found or suggested by the community![/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Raid Battles: [/b]Raid battles give you a high-risk, high-reward opportunity to snag extra supplies for your caravan or villa. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Pitched Battles[/b]: For when you just want a no-holds-barred showdown, Pitched Battles pit your army directly against the enemy's in a straight-up clash.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We recently detailed these new battle types here on our blog, so check all the details: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1296660/view/521974358344729046"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p][b]New-user experience[/b]: Based on your input from Early Access playthroughs, we've pinpointed that the first 30 minutes to an hour felt a bit slow and story-heavy for some, with extended dialogues and setup in the starting villa pulling focus away from the battles and caravan management. We've heard you loud and clear: less talking, more action! Starting today, this new-user experience is now available to players! 🏆
[/p][/*][/list][p]We also went into all the details on what this looks like here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1296660/view/508463020330975862"][/dynamiclink][/p][previewyoutube="ukVAbQsuErM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2] [b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Gamepad Input Rework[/b]: We have reworked gamepad controls to allow gamepad players to do everything keyboard and mouse players can. This includes area select, queuing movement commands, and separating select and move. A LOT has changed, so gamepad players, be sure to check out the updated controls in the Options before you play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aggressive/Defensive Stances[/b]: Replaced the hold command with toggleable stances (V on KBM, RB on gamepad)—Aggressive for proactive attacks (default), Defensive for staying put while fighting back. Plus, a new stop command (C on KBM, Y on gamepad) for precise control in battles. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Show Upcoming Events[/b]: Tokens drop down on the road as you progress, allowing you to better anticipate when an event is coming. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passive Ability Cooldowns on HUD[/b]: Friendly squads now display passives with cooldowns in the squad indicator bar for better tactical awareness. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Type Preview[/b]: See the types of enemies you'll face in the pre-battle squad selector to strategize your lineup. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Optimizations[/b]: Introduced a Steam module for Big Picture/Steam Deck, including virtual keyboard overrides and support for custom configs to enhance portability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Homestead Casting Freedom[/b]: Yara and Elani’s squad portrait now shows in the homestead, allowing you to cast abilities from anywhere in the villa.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased Battle Zoom[/b]: Raised the maximum zoom out distance during battles for a better overview of the skirmish. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Villa Hero Speed Buff[/b]: Heroes gain a small speed boost while in the villa, making navigation quicker. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Narrative Content[/b]: Introduced new conversations in the Villa reacting to spellbook, gallery, and heirloom progress; additional respawn scenes after learning about Vengeance; lore events on death; more Yara and Elani dialogues on respawn; post-Vengeance scenes; completed Turfus story; new Willum story arcs; 10 new Inkyra events exploring her relationship with Voxyra. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Wagon Damage Events[/b]: Added 3 events that can damage your caravan's wagon, adding roguelite tension to travels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Traits[/b]: Created a suite of mantra-based and other traits including Fierce, Cooperative, Ambitious, Cautious, Graceful, Harmonious, Calm, Communal, Lawful, Impulsive, Disorganized, Selfish, Organized, Amoral, Decisive, Unsteady, Fatigued, and Timid [/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement Tutorial Revival[/b]: Brought back the tutorial dialog for movement if not triggered early in the first level (Mouse and Keyboard only).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summon Animation Improvements[/b]: You will now see one unit animating per unit summoned, and if you interrupt a casting unit then the number of summons will be reduced by one. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Trinkets:[/b] Added new active trinkets Sacrifice’s Barb, Flourishing’s Bud, Purity’s Handkerchief, Calculation’s Winding Key, and Dread’s Veil. Added new passive trinkets Frenzy’s Drum, Bravery’s Handwraps, Scrutiny’s Magnifier, Stability’s Bindings, Deceit’s Needle, and Ubiquity’s Lens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Hero Spells:[/b] Added new hero spells Marked for Death, Shrapnel Grenade, and Iron Bastion.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Trinket and Spell VFX:[/b] Added new VFX when casting hero spells or activating trinkets.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Changes to Hope system 🏆[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Losing all Hope no longer ends the run:[/b] When you run out of Hope the run doesn’t end but squads will now “Rout” during battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Routing:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]When Hope is at or reaches 0 during a battle, a timer begins and is displayed around the Hope meter on the HUD. [/p][/*][*][p]When the timer expires a random squad will flee the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p]After a squad flees the timer resets at a shorter duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Routing squads cannot be commanded.[/p][/*][*][p]Yara and Elani never rout.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Removed Retreating[/b]: You can no longer retreat from battles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Dev notes[/b]: Players identified multiple “feel bad” moments in our Hope system. The first was failing a run due to running out of hope from an overworld encounter.  The second was losing a run because you lost enough Hope during the battle to lose the run despite winning the battle itself.

The above changes to the Hope system were made in order to have run losses always occur due to losing all your squads during a battle. The goal of the routing feature is to accelerate you to that loss condition, unless you play fast and efficiently. It makes battles really tense but if you can win and then recover hope on the road it makes for a great player story![/p][p][/p][p]We also removed the retreat feature as part of these changes because it was allowing players to skip battles and not take enough attrition to keep runs progressing toward Hope loss scenarios. We want you to lose due to running out of Hope and retreating was creating too much of a “get out of jail free” option for players. So now you must win the fight or die trying![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Enemy AI Adjustments[/b]: Enemies now have "inertia" (1s ramp-up to max speed after stopping) and slower rotation (540° to 180°), making flanking easier in melee. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Lightning Rod (Hero Spell)[/b]: Made indestructible, always lasts full duration; updated description. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Shock Chain Rework[/b]: Chains can now branch to multiple enemies simultaneously, propagating faster; can chain off material areas like rain clouds, tar walls, and corpses with priority targeting. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Shock + Tar Interaction[/b]: Narrower area, travels farther, deals double damage. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Boulder Toss[/b]: Removed minimum cast range; impact no longer damages caster (still hurts other friendlies). [/p][/*][*][p][b]Target Practice (Hero Spell)[/b]: Reworked to knock back units on impact and explode on each collision; added upgrade values. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Dip & Light (Bow Hero T4/T5)[/b]: Explosion now only damages enemies (no longer sets environment on fire via AOE). [/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive Trap[/b]: Increased hitbox radius from 50 to 100. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Troll Berserker[/b]: No longer gains speed boost during Rampage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lady Vengeance[/b]: Now staggerable except during abilities (can't interrupt them). Fire Line now sets off Explosive Traps. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Aggro[/b]: Squads no longer aggro enemies outside their range, even if attacked. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Victory Conditions[/b]: Levels no longer require killing all enemy summons to complete. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Goblin Sappers[/b]: Fixed stacking Explosive Traps for instant kills. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Aggro Switching[/b]: AI more willing to change targets. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Troll Slammer[/b]: Immune to CC during Puny Creature animation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water/Tar Spreading[/b]: Disabled between non-water/tar objects or identical material objects for performance and visibility. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Raincloud[/b]: Units don't get wet before VFX appears. [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Unit Balance Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Troll Heavy Crossbowman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Crit Multiplier: 5x → 2x[/p][/*][*][p]Crit Chance: 0% → 3%[/p][/*][*][p]Melee Basic Damage: 56.6 → 55.1[/p][/*][*][p]Max Health: 852.5 → 1066[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Normal Crit Units:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Crit Rate: 3% → 2.5%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Quest Clarity[/b]: Improved visual distinction between available and unavailable quests on the map. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Report Enhancements[/b]: Right-click selects squads; Y opens details view; fixed gamepad scrolling. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hope Loss Toasts[/b]: Now show hope lost in Squad/Unit Lost notifications.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Family Ability Toasts[/b]: Display relevant text for daily abilities. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summon Indicators[/b]: Fixed position under squads; ensured status headers (Enraged, Vulnerable, Fear) appear for summons; adjusted Target Dummy status header. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability Descriptions[/b]: Updated Fire Imp to clarify 3-imp squad summon; changed SpawnLimit text to "Max Active Squads". [/p][/*][*][p][b]Routing Vignette[/b]: Hidden during boss battles. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Day/Season Text[/b]: Changed style with transparent background for better readability. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Trinket Names[/b]: Updated capitalization and wording for non-English languages to better convey Chords and Avatars. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Reward/Toast Tints[/b]: Trinkets/heirlooms now tint to rarity color. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Squad Inspector[/b]: Fixed left-padding on equipped trinkets; added scrolling tabs to prevent overflow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Caravan Widget[/b]: Hero health now live-updates in overworld. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hotkeys[/b]: Hide for routed/escaped squads. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Rewards[/b]: Show gained trinkets from raids; consolidate similar types. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Cooldown Display[/b]: No animations on routed/escaped squads; grey out exhausted limited-use abilities. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability Stats[/b]: Now accurate to company upgrades, traits, and trinkets. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Yara & Elani Health[/b]: Shown on squad caravan screen. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Traits Display[/b]: Show for Yara & Elani in squad details characteristics tab. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Give Up Menu[/b]: Moved further down escape menu; reworded prompts and defeat splash. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Size[/b]: Increased for in-game dialogue and objectives on Steam Deck. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Time Conversation[/b]: Fixed text wrapping length. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Global Toast Refactor[/b]: Combined toasts for notifications like Squad Recruitment so less notifications appear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Encounter Rewards[/b]: Fixed header text construction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options Screen[/b]: Fixed Global Illumination Method consistency with quality presets. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Reward Selector[/b]: Fixed Back button visibility on gamepad when viewing Squad Details.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fog of War[/b]: Fixed abnormally dark fog when using non-Lumen GI. [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Audio Enhancements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Lightning Rod SFX[/b]: Added sound for when the rod collapses. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Trinket Casting SFX[/b]: Implemented basic sounds for casting. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Time Sequences[/b]: Revised audio soundscape for immersion. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue Audio[/b]: Fixed issue where continuing with disabled button stopped conversation audio. [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Progression Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Starvation Tag[/b]: Properly applied on load if at 0 food. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Saving[/b]: Only save quests in QuestsCompleted; fixed previously completed quests not showing on map until retriggered. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Orphan's Tears[/b]: Adjusted outcome weights. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Event Fixes[/b]: Fixed grammar/spelling in multiple events (Into the Darkness, All Bets are Off, Canyon Rescue, etc.); fixed Rumor Mill rewards mismatch; prevented full squad loss in A Nest of Strands and Extended Hunt when text indicates survivors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hope Loss Events[/b]: Added new events for running out of hope.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Squad Training[/b]: Now saved in data. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Skip Raid Rewards[/b]: No choice rewards (run, meta, squad, trinket) for raid battles. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Persistent Damage Healing[/b]: No longer heals while starving (0 food) in overworld.
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Crash and Soft Lock Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crashes/soft locks from caravan-stopping effects on reload. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save migration crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed encounters triggering saves during quit, causing invalid states. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Unit and Ability Bugfixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Vital Strikes not dealing damage on Elf Fencer; added hits per unit display for Shear, Reaver Dance, Combo Attack, Vital Strikes. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Invigorating Fugue not healing friendlies when stunned. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Lightning Riders’ teleport being inconsistent on slopes and maintaining aggro after. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Kaboom Crew grenades stopping enemy movement. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shields absorbing damage after deactivation. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Herbal Medicine incorrectly contributing to Healing Done. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Vengeance Scales using stale data; fixed targeting nothing. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed single-unit squads not pushing overlapping units. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed units jittering in regroup and cohesion loss. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed summoned squad limits not being respected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Dummy Rigger animation for Destructive Decoy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Chakram Throw stopping incorrectly and rotated elemental trails. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Pin Down pitchfork always visible. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed navigation pathing through thin walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed heirloom granted to enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water healing non-plants when plant is present. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Elf Mender abilities passing incorrect levels. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Raincloud wetting before VFX. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI and Input Bugfixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed count/trinkets. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed friendly fire tab counting fire damage incorrectly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed destination orientation being inaccurate near bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed limited cast [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Feedback[/b][/h2][p]Thank you for your continued support with Wartorn! Please continue to report bugs and share your feedback with us by joining the official [url="https://discord.gg/7tkCbbXyga"]Discord Server! [/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Backup your save files:[/b][/p][p]Make sure Wartorn isn’t running while you follow these steps:[/p][p]Go to your save game directory. notes.title: Update 1 Incoming: New Battle Types, Revamped New Player Experience, and More!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/94c09b808e1dbe1396dccd9a9c9357031a13b680.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]Update 1 Incoming: New Battle Types, Revamped New Player Experience, and More![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hey Wartorn community![/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that our first major content update is dropping this [b]Thursday, August 28th, at 11:00 AM CT![/b] This update is packed with exciting additions that we've been hard at work on, thanks in large part to your incredible feedback since our Early Access launch. You've helped us shape the game into something even more engaging and strategic, and we can't wait for you to dive in.[/p][p]As a quick recap, this update includes the [b]overhauled new-user experience[/b] we detailed in our last post. We've streamlined the early game to get you into the action faster. If you haven't checked out the full details yet, head over to our previous announcement here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1296660/view/508463020330975862"][/dynamiclink]But that's not all! We're introducing [b]two brand-new battle types[/b] to shake up your strategies and add even more depth to the Isles of Talaur. These high-stakes encounters will test your squad-building skills in fresh ways, offering new risks, rewards, and tactical decisions. Here's the breakdown:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="GEaWscqpPkc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]RAID Battles[/b][/h3][p]RAID battles give you a high-risk, high-reward opportunity to snag extra supplies for your caravan or villa. Here's how they play out:[/p][list][*][p]Your squads approach an enemy encampment, catching them off guard.[/p][/*][*][p]Sneak in, raid caches for valuable resources like coin, food, strands, pages, trinkets—and even rescue refugees to bolster your crew.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies start light but ramp up over time (pro tip: it ties to how many caches you capture, but we'll let you discover the nuances!).[/p][/*][*][p]Escape before the defenders overwhelm you—after you grab a minimum number of caches.[/p][/*][*][p]Raiding takes time, so position your squads wisely for protection.[/p][/*][*][p]Think strategically: divide and conquer for max rewards or regroup for safety?[/p][/*][/list][p]These are perfect for those moments when you need a resource boost but don't want to commit to a full-on war.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]PITCHED Battles[/b][/h3][p]For when you just want a no-holds-barred showdown, PITCHED BATTLES pit your army directly against the enemy's in a straight-up clash:[/p][list][*][p]Armies line up face-to-face—no traversal needed. The fight kicks off immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Smaller, more intimate maps force intense, close-quarters combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Retreat isnt an option, but escaping? Not so easy either (insert dramatic gif here 😉).[/p][/*][*][p]Designed to push you into aggressive, decisive fights without room to run.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're flanking with goblins or unleashing elemental combos with treefolk, these battles will demand your best tactics.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/91e7f51f4f374d70ca7d733edbd374637de52a8d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Arriving August 28[/b] [/h3][p]This update is just the start of our roadmap—we're committed to iterating based on your input, so keep sharing your thoughts on Discord or right here on Steam. Full patch notes with all the tweaks, balances, and fixes will drop alongside the update on Thursday, so stay tuned![/p][p]If you're new to Wartorn or jumping back in, now's the perfect time to harness those elements, build your fantasy crew, and push forward. Thanks for being part of this journey![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield![/p][p][i]The Stray Kite Studios Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p]P.S. Join our Discord for live discussions, dev Q&As, and sneak peeks:[url="https://discord.gg/wartorn"] [/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/7tkCbbXyga"]https://discord.gg/7tkCbbXyga[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Follow us on X, Bluesky, and TikTok for more updates![/p]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/101757b75ce487eb615f0ccb465127fcb5fc9e86.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Patch Notes - Patch 1[/b][/h1][p]Hey everyone! We are excited to share with you our first patch to Wartorn since we launched into Early Access last week! This patch brings new features, balance tweaks, bug fixes, and a ton of polish to enhance your journey through the perilous lands with your caravan. 
[/p][p]Items listed with the 🏆 next to them signify that they were found or suggested by the community![/p][h2]
[b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Speed Options in Overworld: [/b]Added the ability for players to increase the speed of their Caravan when moving through the Overworld. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minimum & Maximum Range Indicators[/b]: A transparent white circle now appears under units when casting abilities, showing the minimum and maximum range for precise targeting. Perfect for planning your squad's next move! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Offscreen Enemy Indicators[/b]: New icons alert you to enemies just out of sight, ensuring you’re never caught off guard in battle. 🏆[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Control Options[/b]: Customize your experience with new settings for camera shake intensity and a pan speed multiplier for Gamepad/WASD/mouse edge-of-screen panning. 🏆[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Developer Notes:[/i][/b] It has been an eye opening first week and it’s been amazing to see the different strategies that have been employed and to hear about what units and family members are standing out. On the whole we are seeing some units stand out as the clear “best” units and players are not exploring some of the other units as a result.  The changes below are an attempt to nerf the ones that are head and shoulders better than the others so that more units feel like viable options.[/p][p]You will also notice that there are a lot more nerfs than buffs in this list.  Turns out you all are very good at the game and are, honestly, not failing enough! This is leading to our story not unfolding as quickly as it should and the meta progression doesn’t get to shine because you don’t feel like you need it that much.  These changes are all part of trying to get the overworld resources, battle difficulty, and challenge level where we think it will provide the most entertaining Rogue-lite experience.  We welcome your feedback after you have had a chance to try out these changes.

In general we are finding healing too powerful and not allowing for the levels of attrition that we want which should encourage players to try more units and bring units in “off the bench” to allow their best units a chance to heal on the journey and keep battles fresher by causing players to try different strategies while their units recover.

Some of the tanks are also underperforming at their role so a few of the tanks have received HP buffs.[/p][h3][b]Unit Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Health Adjustments[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Human Clucks and Voxyra have proven to be the best of the family members. So much so that players are only taking one route to get to Tabenrahzi. notes.title: Wartorn Hits Early Access on June 17
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/91f7f08b44d092817afd566e3f99ce17b4335b72.gif[/img]

Hey there, everyone! We’ve been anxious to share this news, and the day is finally here: Wartorn, our real-time tactics roguelite, is launching[b] in Early Access on June 17, 2025[/b]! It’ll be priced at $29.99, but for launch week, you can grab it for just [b]$19.99. [/b]

If you played our Steam Next Fest demo (huge thanks to everyone who did!), you just got a taste of what Wartorn’s combat is about. However, we are also excited to share more details about what the larger game will be like! Including the roguelite progression system, larger narrative, and more! See below for some of these details and visit some of your favorite gaming outlets as they are sharing their preview coverage now too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/9e6358ec6c93975c8a88999b24a2f4f1a64f50f8.gif[/img]

Led by our Creative Director, Paul Hellquist (who was lead designer on BioShock and creative director on Borderlands 2), the game follows two elven sisters on a heartfelt quest to reunite their family. You’ll face tough choices and dive into thrilling battles using elemental and physics-based systems. We’ve been hard at work since the demo, and we’re so excited to show you what’s coming in Early Access.

[h2]What to Expect in Wartorn[/h2]

Here’s a quick look at the core of the game:

⚔ [b]Tactical Combat[/b]: Wield fire, water, lightning, and more to outsmart enemies. Ignite tar, electrify puddles, or destroy the battlefield to gain the upper hand. Every fight feels dynamic and unique.

🧨 [b]Destructible Environments[/b]: No two battles play out the same, thanks to physics-driven chaos that lets you reshape the terrain.

⌛ [b]Slow-Time Feature:[/b] Need a moment to think? Slow down time to plan your moves and issue precise commands, making even intense fights approachable.

🎨 [b]Stunning Art:[/b] Our painterly visuals bring the world to life, with heroes, enemies, and landscapes that look gorgeous, even in the game’s darker moments.

[h2]Brand-New Reveals[/h2]

We’re thrilled to share some features we’re showing off for the first time today:

➕ [b]The Villa Hub[/b]: Meet the Villa, your adventure’s home base! It’s packed with interactions for upgrades, weapon changes, passive abilities, and more… and a cozy vibe.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/4697919a38dbec5a43b61d77cc214770c7510767.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/4697919a38dbec5a43b61d77cc214770c7510767.gif[/img][/url]

➕ [b]Roguelite Progression Systems[/b]: Dive into the full progression system, where you’ll unlock heirlooms, trinkets, upgrade heroes, gain new abilities, and more! It’s your chance to master the game’s core loops and see how every run builds on the last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/a255f1e5428b7f303a5c2a629999b66c7e2754e6.jpg[/img]

➕ [b]Upgraded Combat[/b]: Since the Steam Next Fest demo, we’ve added more unit variety to the core combat, giving you even more ways to strategize and dominate the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/8199625a2f4468509f67da226772f5f862a25ead.gif[/img]

➕ [b]Expanded Narrative[/b]: Get ready to experience Wartorn’s larger story! Your dialog choices and decisions will shape the sisters’ journey, with emotional moments that hit hard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/17409a6b3094d1fc26456bdfe7f42b84c04cccef.jpg[/img]

➕ [b]Overworld Map[/b]: Explore the Overworld Map, which shows off the massive scale of your journey. With branching paths and unexpected outcomes, every choice leads to new challenges. Be sure to monitor your hope, your food, and take care of your squads!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/edb08b998bdd020bc0df33f0c2ba31fa6de4c14e.gif[/img]

[h3]Want a peek? Check out some raw gameplay, showing these new features in action![/h3]

[previewyoutube=69WkChr37sQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Why Early Access?[/h2]

We’re launching in Early Access because we want you—our incredible players—to help shape Wartorn’s future. Other great games became amazing thanks to community feedback, and we’re taking the same approach. Since the demo, we’ve polished combat, added new units, and built out the Villa, Overworld Map, and story. Now we need your thoughts to make Wartorn even better. This is our journey together!

[h2]Join the Fun![/h2]

Want to chat with us and other fans? Join our Discord, follow us on X, BlueSky, Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok, and let’s connect! We’ll be sharing dev updates, answering questions, and maybe even tossing in some surprises.

June 17 is just around the corner, and we can’t wait to see you dive into Wartorn’s world of tactics, choices, and epic moments. Are you excited? Let us know in the comments or on socials! 

Oh, and be sure to give us a wishlist if you don’t mind and tell your friends! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296660/Wartorn/ 

Cheers,
The Stray Kite Studios Team

notes.title: Wartorn Updates – Your Feedback in Action - April 11, 2025
notes.content:
Hey there, Wartorn community! I’m thrilled to share the latest scoop on what we’ve been cooking up for the game following the release of our Combat Demo. You’ve been dropping some incredible feedback, and we’ve been all ears—tweaking, building, and polishing Wartorn based on what you’ve told us. Here’s a rundown of the updates we’re bringing to the table when we launch in Early Access here very soon! 👀

[previewyoutube=uCKsjYFtTp4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Squad Controls: More Power in Your Hands[/h2]

You asked for smoother squad management, and we’re delivering. Now, you can queue up move and attack commands for your squads—no more babysitting every step. We’ve also added a squad select screen where you can pick the order they roll into battle. Want your toughest units leading the charge? You got it. Oh, and you can assign squads to hotkeys 1-5 however you like. It’s all about giving you total control. 

[h2]Options Menu Overhaul[/h2]

We heard you loud and clear that our demo did not have enough options for you to tweak. We knew this going in, so we are happy to say that we're beefing up the options menu big time for Early Access. Think full-on graphics settings, audio sliders—everything you need to tailor Wartorn to your setup. Whether you’re maxing out the visuals or tuning the sound to catch every battle cry, it’s your call.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/0b25109a3925ace76c6096f91bbc805c7870cde2.gif[/img]


[h2]Visuals That Pop [/h2]

We’ve updated the post-processing and upgraded unit textures and materials to make them stand out sharp and clear against the environment. We still have our unique art-style that we are proud of, but we are continuing to refine this experience so that every squad’s going to look epic and run smoothly.


[h2]More Missions, More Units[/h2]

Variety’s the name of the game here. With our combat demo, we intentionally kept it very limited… focused on… well, combat. We have lots more to show soon, including the larger Roguelite progression systems, our Homestead… etc, but for now..  say hello to Warlord Battles—a fresh battle type to mix things up. More details will be shared soon, but it's something for you to chew on. And for units? We’ve more than doubled the number of unit trees from the original set, plus every tree now has Tier 2 options. That’s a ton more strategies and combos to play with—bring on the chaos! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/77382fa6ce1b8554b8dd9e5c993835d004938a91.gif[/img]

[h2]Smoother Pathing & Navigation[/h2]

Pathing’s getting some big improvements too. Squads can now glide through friendly units without tripping over each other, and waypoints make plotting your moves a breeze. We’ve also added off-screen indicators so you always know where the action’s at. No more getting lost mid-fight!

[h2]Melee Combat & Unit Roles[/h2]

Melee battles are about to feel way better, especially when three or more squads are slugging it out—less clunk, more punch. Plus, we’ve sharpened unit roles: Tanks soak up damage, DPS dishes it out, and Support keeps everyone standing. Every unit’s got a job, and it shows.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/c73c26cf8892406d595174c16d0a32a469edbf66.jpg[/img]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

That’s just some of the improvements we are bringing to Wartorn—all inspired by your feedback. We’re so grateful for how you’ve helped shape Wartorn into something awesome, and we’re putting the finishing touches on everything for launch. Want to help us get there? Give us a wishlist! —it’s a huge boost and gets you locked in for day one. Got more ideas? Jump into our [url=https://discord.gg/7tkCbbXyga]Discord[/url] to chat with us and the community—we’d love to hear from you.

Thanks for going on this journey with us! Drop your thoughts below—what do you think of these changes? Can’t wait to see you on the battlefield soon!

The Wartorn Team

notes.title: Wartorn Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/474a2898313308f65fc51ec81c00e87895cac75d.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

We have some exciting news—[b]Wartorn[/b] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest this month[/b], giving you an exclusive first look at our combat demo! From [b]February 24 to March 3[/b], you’ll have the chance to dive into [b]Wartorn’s[/b] intense squad-based battles and experience elemental warfare firsthand.

This demo is designed to give you a [b]taste of the core gameplay mechanics,[/b] highlighting the [b]moment-to-moment combat[/b] that makes [b]Wartorn[/b] both strategic and visceral. We’ve carefully chosen units, maps, and elemental interactions to showcase the variety and depth of our battles—[b]but this is just the beginning of what’s to come![/b]

[h2]What to Expect in the Combat Demo[/h2]

This [b]combat-focused demo[/b] will introduce you to some of the key mechanics of Wartorn’s real-time tactics gameplay, but it [b]will not[/b] include the larger narrative, roguelite progression, or meta systems—[b]we’re saving those for Early Access![/b]

Here’s what you’ll get your hands on in Next Fest:

🔥 [b]Dynamic Elemental Combat[/b] – Experiment with Fire, Lightning, Tar, Water, and Plant elements to create explosive combos, influence enemy movement, and manipulate the battlefield to best fit your strategy.

⚔️ [b]11 Unique Unit Types [/b]– Each battle will offer different squad rewards, meaning you might need multiple runs to experience all of them!

Units include: 
[list]
[*] Elf Bolt Mage
[*] Elf Rainmaker
[*] Goblin Grenadier
[*] Goblin Limb Thrasher Rabble
[*] Goblin Angry Mob
[*] Goblin Novice Brewer
[*] Human Vanguard Spearmen
[*] Styg Fire Acolyte
[*] Styg Ichor Defender
[*] Pheign Heartwood Stomper
[*] Troll Club Clomper
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/74ddc5e90dcebd45cc9a15d01bd61dfb64bff70b.gif[/img]

👑 [b]Playable Hero Squad: Yara & Elani [/b]– These elven sisters lead the charge with powerful and unique abilities. Do not let your heroes die… if they do, you will fail! 

🌍 [b]Four Battle Maps in a Single Biome[/b] – Get a taste of the diverse environments of the isles of Talaur, with fully destructible battlefields that make every fight dynamic and unpredictable.

🎲 [b]Randomized Battle Rewards[/b] – After each victory, you’ll unlock new squad members, giving you the chance to experiment with different team compositions. (In Early Access, rewards will include upgrades, passive/active abilities, and resources to shape your journey.)

⏳ [b]Slow Down Time[/b] - With the slow-time feature (space-bar), even the most complex scenarios are approachable, allowing players to slow down, analyze the chaos, and issue precise commands, adapting gameplay to suit their pace. 

👀 [b]Work-in-Progress HUD & Controls[/b] – We want your feedback! The HUD is still evolving, and we’ll be monitoring community input to make it the best it can be before Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441203/7e99483aad9bac80e3ca7474d663336c7cd8c55a.gif[/img]

[h2]What’s Not in the Demo [/h2]

To set expectations, this Next Fest demo is laser-focused on [b]combat[/b], meaning some of the [b]full game’s deeper mechanics aren’t included just yet:[/b]

❌ [b]The Narrative & Story Setup[/b] – You won’t see why Yara and Elani are fighting or how their journey unfolds—but rest assured, a rich, emotional story awaits in the full game!

❌ [b]Roguelite Progression[/b] – The meta-game and long-term upgrades, like unlocking persistent abilities, squad veterancy, or story-driven progression, aren’t here yet.

❌ [b]Caravan Management[/b] – In the full game, this is where you’ll manage and swap squads for each run, assign trinkets, and apply veterancy upgrades—but it won’t be accessible in this demo.

❌ [b]Boss Battles[/b] – The full game will feature challenging boss encounters, but we’re holding those back for Early Access!

[h2]We Need Your Feedback![/h2]

Next Fest isn’t just about letting you play—it’s [b]our chance to hear from you![/b] We’ll have a [b]Discord section[/b] set up[b] just for demo feedback[/b], so let us know what you think about:

✅ [b]Controls & UI[/b] – Does everything feel intuitive? Are there improvements you’d like to see?

✅ [b]Combat Balance[/b] – Which units feel powerful? Which could use some tweaks?

✅ [b]Overall Feel[/b] – What excites you most? What would make Wartorn even better?

This is just the [b]first step[/b] in making [b]Wartorn[/b] the best game it can be, and [b]your input will shape the future of the game [/b]as we head toward [b]Early Access.[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/7tkCbbXyga]Join the Official Wartorn Discord[/url]

[h2]Wishlist & Get Ready to Fight![/h2]

The Next Fest [b]Wartorn[/b] Combat Demo will be available beginning on [b]February 24[/b], and we can’t wait for you to try it. Be sure to [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b] and [b]join our Discord[/b] to share your thoughts after playing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296660/Wartorn/ 

This is just the beginning of the adventure—see you in the Wartorn [i]isles of Talaur[/i]!

🔥 [b]The Wartorn Development Team [/b]🔥
